description: Defines interfaces and classes for CU-UP processor, including E1AP communication, management notifications, and UE handling within the ocudu::ocucp namespace.

classes.name: cu_up_processor_e1ap_interface
classes.description: Interface for E1AP notifier to communicate with the CU-UP processor, providing methods for handling setup requests, resets, and accessing related handlers.

classes.name: cu_up_processor_cu_up_management_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying CU-UP specific events such as new connections and removal requests.

classes.name: cu_up_ue_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling UE index updates.

classes.name: cu_up_processor
classes.description: Main interface combining E1AP communication and UE handling for the CU-UP processor.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancel pending tasks for a given UE to allow safe removal.

methods.name: handle_cu_up_e1_setup_request
methods.description: Handle GNB-CU-UP E1 Setup Request message and respond accordingly.

methods.name: handle_cu_cp_e1_reset_message
methods.description: Initiate E1 Reset procedure as per TS 38.483.

methods.name: get_e1ap_message_handler
methods.description: Access the E1AP message handler interface.

methods.name: get_e1ap_bearer_context_manager
methods.description: Access the E1AP bearer context manager.

methods.name: get_e1ap_bearer_context_removal_handler
methods.description: Access the E1AP bearer context removal handler.

methods.name: on_new_cu_up_connection
methods.description: Notify about a new CU-UP connection.

methods.name: on_cu_up_remove_request_received
methods.description: Notify about a CU-UP removal request.

methods.name: update_ue_index
methods.description: Update the index of a UE.

methods.name: get_e1ap_handler
methods.description: Retrieve the E1AP handler for the CU-UP.
